description: Appends songs to the end of a playlist. Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. For your own playlists (API key), anonymous ones you made (edit_token), and open ones anyone can edit.

edit_token.description: The edit_token create_playlist returned for an anonymous playlist (made without an API key). Not needed for your own account's playlists.

playlist.description: The playlist's id ("abc123" or "username/abc123") or its great.dj link

songs.description: Each song is a {"id": "<YouTube video id>"} object (preferred: free and exact) or an "Artist - Title" string, looked up on YouTube (slow, and limited per hour). Reuse the video ids returned by search_songs and earlier calls instead of looking songs up again. At most 100 per call.

name: add_songs

edit_token.description: Anonymous playlists only: needed to edit it later. Can't be recovered.

owner.description: Username, or null for anonymous playlists

private.description: Only its owner can edit it (anyone with the link can listen)

id.description: YouTube video id: reuse it instead of the title

unmatched.description: Songs that weren't found on YouTube (not added)

title: Add songs
